title: We can't open your data

intro.keyLost: Your Journeys are still stored on this phone, but the key that unlocks them isn't here anymore. This usually happens after restoring a backup that didn't include the phone's secure storage.
intro.corrupt: Your Journeys are still stored on this phone, but the file wouldn't open. It may have been cut short while it was being saved.
intro.malformed: Your Journeys are still stored on this phone, and the app couldn't make sense of them. This one is on us, not on your phone.

kept: Nothing has been deleted. We've set the file aside exactly as it is, and the app won't write anything over it.
privacy: Your data is encrypted so nobody else can read it, including us. That same protection is why we can't unlock it for you.
tryAgainFailed: Still no luck. If you've just restarted your phone, unlock it and try once more.

confirm.title: Start fresh?
confirm.body: This deletes the data we couldn't open, including the copy we set aside. If you delete it, we can't bring it back.
